title: Webhook message
description: The JSON body Helm POSTs to a webhook (docs/webhooks.md). Fields may be added.

type.description: task.created, task.updated, task.completed, task.deleted, task.restored, now.changed or webhook.test (values may be added)

data.description: task: the task after the change (task.schema.json); now.changed adds isNow; webhook.test has webhookId

previous.description: The changed fields' values before the change; {} for a new task
